items.title: 🔴 LIVE: TN Gets First Anthropic Claude Innovation Lab | Anupam Mittal on AI Pricing | Front Page
items.summary:
GWC Data.AI opened Tamil Nadu's first Anthropic Claude Innovation Lab in Hosur, inaugurated by Anthropic India MD Irina Ghose and former ISRO director Mylswamy Annadurai. In domestic tech debates, Shaadi.com founder Anupam Mittal sparked widespread discussion by declaring "India is where pricing strategies come to die," highlighting how global AI pricing models clash with local market realities as IT majors pivot toward outcome-based contracts. Globally, Micron invested $10 billion into a new US R&D lab, AI leaders introduced zero data retention policies, Unitree surged 460% in its debut IPO, and MWire Labs founder Badal Nyalang joins us to discuss Lemka Voice AI.

This is your Front Page LIVE, bringing you sharp analysis of the biggest technology, business, policy and economic stories shaping India and the world.

items.title: IT Revenue Per Employee Rises | India Bans 405 Defence Imports | Front Page
items.summary:
Top Indian IT firms reported a rise in Q1 revenue per employee, though analysts attribute nearly 60% of these productivity gains to workforce rationalization rather than pure AI efficiency. In policy developments, India announced a phased ban on importing 405 defence components under its sixth indigenisation list to create a ₹3,070 crore domestic market. Globally, Chinese video platform Bilibili released its English site, while India's retail GCCs face a deficit of senior AI leaders, and Punjab Cabinet Minister Aman Arora joins us to unpack Mohali's AI roadmap alongside InGovern's Shriram Subramanian on Tata Group's tech bets.

This is your Front Page LIVE, bringing you sharp analysis of the biggest technology, business, policy and economic stories shaping India and the world.
